extraction.notes: ESS reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric in these pages, so affo_total and affo fields are null. Current-quarter (three months ended June 30, 2022) column used. Share count printed as 67,566,748 and converted to thousands (67,566.748). Check: 211,336/67,566.748 = 3.13 and 248,678/67,566.748 = 3.68. Zero-valued dash lines (Gains not included in FFO, Loss on early retirement of debt, Co-investment promote income, Income from early redemption) recorded as 0. Same reconciliation appears on seq 17 (page S-3) with identical figures. Footnote markers (1), (2) were kept as printed in labels. Recurring capex: ESS does not present an AFFO section here, so recurring_capex_disclosed set to null; no capex figure from another table was used. The page_printed for seq 10 is blank in the marker (printed page 7 per footer).
